profile.pronunciation_convention: IPA (Latin American seseo); spoken = informal stress hint
profile.grammar_notes: Two copulas: ser for identity, origin and traits; estar for location and current state. Existence with hay (invariable form of haber). Subject pronouns usually dropped because verb endings mark the person. Negation with no before the verb. Questions by intonation or with accented question words (qué, quién, dónde, cuándo, cómo, cuánto, cuál, por qué), a closed set. want = querer, can = poder, must = tener que, go = ir (plans: ir a + infinitive), have = tener (also age). Politeness via tú vs usted (grammatical). Accents distinguish words: sí/si, qué/que, él/el, tú/tu. Closed sets: subject pronouns, question words, articles, days of the week.
